hitl_policy.sw: Dawa na tiba ni maamuzi ya daktari — agent inaonyesha na kuomba ruhusa tu.
hitl_policy.en: Medication and treatment are clinician decisions — agents advise and require HITL.

summary.sw: Vipimo vya wagonjwa, zanzari, oksijeni, friji za chanjo na alerti za hospitali.
summary.en: Patient vitals, ICU beds, oxygen, vaccine fridges and hospital alerts.

hitl_policy.sw: Kufunga/kufungua, siren na locks zinahitaji ruhusa — kamwe automatic.
hitl_policy.en: Locks, sirens and disarm need human approval — never automatic.

summary.sw: CCTV, sensors ya mlango, motion detectors, sirens na alarmi.
summary.en: CCTV, door sensors, motion detectors, sirens and alarms.

hitl_policy.sw: Taa na sockets: automatic kwa kanuni; nyuma ya lock na energy kubwa: HITL.
hitl_policy.en: Lights/sockets: rules-driven automation; high-power or lock-adjacent actions: HITL.

summary.sw: Taa, sockets, sensors ya joto/maji, energy monitoring na automation ya kanuni.
summary.en: Lights, sockets, temp/leak sensors, energy monitoring and rules automation.

hitl_policy.sw: Valve ya maji/pampu inahitaji idhini kabla ya kufunguliwa (gharama + usalama).
hitl_policy.en: Irrigation valves/pumps need approval before actuation (cost + safety).

summary.sw: Udhuwilishaji, unyevu wa udongo, hali ya hewa shambani na pampu.
summary.en: Irrigation, soil moisture, on-farm weather and pumps.
